title: Console backend: retention settings + enforcement status endpoints (RBAC + audit events)
author: Jada Williams
release_notes: Adds feature-flagged Console backend APIs for tenant retention configuration and enforcement visibility, including RBAC gating and admin audit events on policy changes.
body:
Summary: This PR adds the Console backend endpoints required for v1 retention controls: read/write retention policy, compute/display effective policy, and surface enforcement status (last run, lag/backlog, error summary, legal hold/exceptions indicators). All endpoints are gated behind the retention_controls_v1 feature flag and enforce tenant-scoped RBAC. Any policy mutation emits an admin audit event with actor + before/after policy snapshot metadata.

Context: The control plane now supports persistence + evaluation of retention policies (ENG-2912 / PR #18437). Console needs stable APIs to (a) render the retention settings page, (b) show the computed effective policy (after precedence/guardrails), and (c) show enforcement transparency for enterprise security reviews (see SUP-4831 + INT-912).

API surface (console-backend): GET /console/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/retention/policy -> returns configured policy at tenant scope (or null if default-only). PUT /console/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/retention/policy -> validates + persists policy (tenant scope), returns stored policy + effective policy, emits audit event. GET /console/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/retention/effective -> returns effective policy (includes resolved precedence and guardrail clamping). GET /console/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/retention/enforcement-status -> returns latest enforcement run + counters per supported dataset type (audit_logs, admin_activity, request_metadata, telemetry_eligible_tables).

RBAC: Introduces permissions retention:read and retention:write under the Console admin permission bundle. Access rules: retention:read required for GET endpoints; retention:write required for PUT; all routes require tenant_admin (existing) OR fine-grained permissions (new) depending on deployment. Private deployments: routes available but enforcement-status may return partial data with "source=customer-managed" when enforcement is external.

Audit logging: On PUT policy, emit event type admin.retention_policy.updated with fields: tenant_id, actor_user_id, actor_role, request_id, previous_policy_hash, new_policy_hash, changed_keys (computed), and a redacted policy snapshot (no freeform notes). Also emits admin.retention_policy.validation_failed for 4xx validation failures (includes reasons + attempted guardrail ranges, excludes raw payload).

Implementation notes: - Uses the policy-eval library from PR #18437 to compute effective policy server-side; the Console UI should not replicate precedence logic. - Validation maps control-plane errors to stable Console error codes (RETENTION_POLICY_INVALID, RETENTION_POLICY_OUT_OF_RANGE, RETENTION_POLICY_LEGAL_HOLD_REQUIRED, RETENTION_FEATURE_DISABLED). - Enforcement status is read from the retention_enforcement_runs table via the telemetry service API (behind service auth); this avoids direct DB reads from console-backend.

Testing: - Added integration tests for RBAC gating (read vs write), feature flag behavior, and audit event emission. - Added determinism tests that effective policy matches policy-eval golden vectors for a few representative tenants (hosted + dedicated). - Added contract tests for enforcement-status response schema to prevent UI breakage.

Rollout plan: Land behind retention_controls_v1. Console UI will call these endpoints once DES-144/PR #18544 is enabled for internal tenants. We will enable in staging first, then canary a handful of hosted tenants, then widen.

Notes for reviewers: Most of the code is in console-backend/services/retention/* and the RBAC additions in authz/permissions.ts. The enforcement-status endpoint is intentionally conservative about returning internal dataset/table names (we return dataset_type + high-level counts only).

Commits: 1) console-backend: add retention routes scaffold + feature flag gating 2) authz: add retention:read/write permissions and tenant scoping helpers 3) retention: wire policy read/write to control-plane client 4) retention: add effective policy endpoint using policy-eval library 5) retention: add enforcement status endpoint backed by telemetry service 6) audit: emit admin retention policy audit events + redaction 7) tests: RBAC + audit event + contract tests for response schema 8) docs: internal API notes for Console UI consumers

Changed areas/files (high level): - services/console-backend/src/routes/retention.ts - services/console-backend/src/controllers/retention_controller.ts - services/console-backend/src/services/retention/retention_service.ts - services/console-backend/src/clients/control_plane/retention_policies_client.ts - services/console-backend/src/clients/telemetry/enforcement_status_client.ts - services/console-backend/src/authz/permissions.ts - services/console-backend/src/audit/admin_audit_events.ts - services/console-backend/test/integration/retention_policy_rbac.test.ts - services/console-backend/test/integration/retention_policy_audit.test.ts - services/console-backend/test/contract/retention_enforcement_status.schema.test.ts

Illustrative snippet (controller error mapping): if (err.code === 'POLICY_OUT_OF_RANGE') return res.status(400).json({ code: 'RETENTION_POLICY_OUT_OF_RANGE', details: err.details });

Review conversation (abridged): Chloe Martin: Can we avoid returning any raw table names in enforcement-status? Also please ensure the response is stable for UI caching. Jada Williams: Updated response to only include dataset_type + counts + timestamps; added contract test to lock schema. Kaitlyn Nguyen: RBAC check currently allows org_admin across tenants; should be tenant-scoped only. Jada Williams: Fixed to require tenant scope; added regression test for cross-tenant access denial. Marcus Lin: Audit event should include changed keys and policy hashes; please do not log the full payload on validation failures. Jada Williams: Added changed_keys + hashes; validation_failed event now contains reason codes only (no raw payload). Kevin Osei: For Private, enforcement-status may be customer-managed; can we reflect that so SEs can explain it? Jada Williams: Added source field (redwood|customer-managed) with nullable counters; documented behavior in route docstring. Jordan Lee: Effective policy should come from policy-eval library to ensure precedence correctness; avoid duplicating logic. Jada Williams: Refactored to call policy-eval; added golden vectors.

CI: build (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration-tests (pass), lint (pass). Initial integration test flaked due to clock skew in enforcement-status timestamps; fixed by freezing time in test harness and reran.

Merge: Squash merged into main.
